scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @news-agent/api && npm run build -w @news-agent/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @news-agent/shared && npm run build -w @news-agent/news && npm run build -w @news-agent/db && npm run build -w @news-agent/personalization && npm run build -w @news-agent/tools && npm run build -w @news-agent/agent
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @news-agent/shared && npm run build -w @news-agent/db && npm run dev -w @news-agent/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
